title: Clinical Validation of Medical-based Large Language Model Chatbots on Ophthalmic Patient Queries with LLM-based Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of the 'Objectivity' metric in the S.C.O.R.E. framework, where human experts (ophthalmologists) and an LLM judge (GPT-4-Turbo) rate generated responses on a 1-5 Likert scale to determine if they are objective and unbiased against gender.
